visualCharacteristics: Centred intro heading above a row of product cards (picture, title, text, CTA button), finished by a closing line with a CTA; variants add boxed card chrome, icon cards or step layouts.
contentPattern: Rows are classified by content: rows before the first picture row form the intro (eyebrow, heading, lead); each row with a picture is one card (picture, h3 title, text, CTA paragraph, <em><a> for an outline button); rows after the cards form the closing (title paragraph + CTA paragraph).
usage: Use for a titled set of product or feature cards with an intro and a closing call to action.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any intro-plus-card-row section and pick variant classes (boxed, icons, steps, landing) for the card style rather than building a new card block.
